title: Kōnenki — the word her family never said (menopause stigma across cultures)
caption:
Only 6.8% of US medical residents felt ready to manage menopause (Mayo Clinic Proceedings, 2019). Ask for a menopause-certified clinician. Send this to your mum.
Told it's just age?
www.aiforheratx.org
#menopause #perimenopause #womenshealth #menopausestigma #midlifewomen

phrases: So I googled it at 1am, alone, again.

scenes.text: Japan has no single word for menopause. The silence is *cultural*, not proof that you're fine.
phrases: Margaret Lock compared Japan and Canada, 1993.
Japanese women reported far fewer hot flashes.
Culture writes the script; her body was still real.

scenes.text: Tonight: start a 2-week log of flashes, sleep and mood, and *bring* it to the appointment.
phrases: Log flashes, sleep and mood for 2 weeks.
Ask the clinic: "Is anyone here menopause-certified?"
150 min of brisk walking a week (WHO); 1,200 mg calcium daily after 51 (NIH ODS).
